en: Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing three views: a riverside townscape with a multi‑arched stone bridge and church spire; an inset of a church labelled "DIE DEUTSCHE KIRCHE"; and another inset of a large school building labelled "DAS GYMNASIUM". The right half is filled with handwritten German text and floral decoration around the printed greeting "Gruss aus Goldingen".
